title: Act 2 - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Act 2 in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A cave holding Elerim and the Chalium drop from the Chromatic Challier. Its entrance Flag is a useful landmark for the left-wall route to Elerim.
